label: 510(k) Medical Device — 510(k) Summary
description: 510(k) Summary per 21 CFR 807.92 for NeuroSense Pro cEEG monitor.

inputs.submitter_address: 1200 Bay Street, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94133
inputs.intended_use: The NeuroSense Pro is intended for non-invasive recording, display, and storage of electroencephalographic (EEG) signals in adult and pediatric patients (≥2 years) in hospital settings. The device provides continuous monitoring with automated ML-assisted seizure detection alerting to support clinical decision-making by qualified healthcare professionals. The ML seizure detection feature is adjunctive and is not intended as a standalone diagnostic.
inputs.device_description_summary: 32-channel wireless cEEG system comprising an electrode headset (Ag/AgCl, BLE 5.2 wireless), bedside base station (processing, display, HL7 FHIR), and CortexAI software suite (real-time display, ML seizure detection with 94% sensitivity, report generation). IEC 62304 Class B software.
inputs.se_summary: The NeuroSense Pro has the same intended use and fundamental technology (scalp EEG acquisition/display) as the predicate NicoletOne system. Differences include increased channel count (32 vs 25), wireless data link, and ML-based seizure detection. Performance testing demonstrates equivalent or superior signal quality (52 dB vs 48 dB SNR). New features are well-characterized and do not raise new safety/effectiveness questions.
inputs.bench_findings: All signal quality, impedance, battery life, and durability tests passed
inputs.biocompat_findings: Cytotoxicity, sensitization, irritation all passed per ISO 10993
inputs.elec_findings: IEC 60601-1 and 60601-1-2 compliance confirmed for safety and EMC
inputs.sw_findings: All unit, integration, and system test cases passed. Seizure detection validated on 2,400 annotated events (94.2% sensitivity, 96.1% specificity)
inputs.clin_findings: Prospective clinical validation study (N=200 ICU patients): automated seizure detection concordance with expert EEG reader was 93.8% (κ=0.87)
inputs.summary_conclusions: The NeuroSense Pro is substantially equivalent to the predicate device. It has the same intended use, comparable technological characteristics, and demonstrated equivalent or superior performance. The device is safe and effective for its intended use.
